# LUD-05

## Summary

LNURL-fast specification. Fast authentication without polling.

`author: fiatjaf`

[LUD-0](0.md)
[LUD-2](2.md)

## Specification

LNURL-fast optimizes the authentication flow by reducing round trips.
Instead of polling, it uses a long-lived session token.

## Improvements

- Reduced latency for auth flows
- Better UX for mobile wallets
- Session persistence across app restarts
